optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Operations Process Specialist, Collaboration Software Subscriptions

professionalSummary.text: Candidate has experience managing renewal-processing procedures for business subscriptions in the billing system.
professionalSummary.witness: Processed monthly and annual renewals for business subscriptions in the billing system, checking seat counts against the customer's admin console export before each invoice run.

experienceHighlights.text: Candidate maintains the billing-correction checklist and the list of known correction causes.
experienceHighlights.witness: Maintained the billing-correction checklist and the running list of correction causes (seat-count drift, expired purchase orders, currency mismatch), adding a pre-invoice seat check after a wave of seat-count corrections.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Candidate has implemented a pre-invoice seat check to reduce manual corrections in the renewal process.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Added a pre-invoice seat check after a wave of seat-count corrections. Candidate's cover email: 'After I introduced the pre-invoice seat check, manual corrections dropped from about one in five renewals to almost none.' No report or figure source was attached.

skills.text: Candidate coordinates disputed invoices with finance and customer success.
skills.witness: Handled disputed invoices with finance and customer success through the dispute queue; credit notes above the agreed limit were approved by the finance controller.
